name: Protect Secrets
description: Blocks Claude from reading or printing sensitive files like .env, private keys, and AWS credentials to the terminal.
author: disler

name: Block Dangerous Commands
description: Intercepts Bash tool calls and denies execution of destructive patterns like rm -rf at the filesystem root.
author: disler

name: Prompt Injection Guard
description: Scans incoming user prompts for known prompt-injection patterns and blocks the turn before Claude processes them.
author: lasso-security

name: Auto-format on Edit
description: Runs Prettier or ESLint on any file written or edited by Claude, keeping the codebase consistently formatted.
author: disler

name: Run Tests After Write
description: Triggers the project test suite automatically every time Claude writes a file, surfacing regressions immediately.
author: karanb192

name: TDD Enforcer
description: Blocks Claude from writing implementation code unless a corresponding test file already exists, enforcing test-driven development.
author: disler

name: Git Checkpoint
description: Creates an automatic git commit before any risky tool call, giving you a rollback point without manual intervention.
author: karanb192

name: Audio Alert on Stop
description: Plays an audio chime when Claude finishes its turn, so you know when to look back at the terminal.
author: disler

name: Slack Notification
description: Posts a Slack message when Claude stops, including a summary of the last action — useful for async or long-running tasks.
author: ChrisWiles

name: Auto-load Context
description: Automatically injects project-specific context files at session start so Claude always has the latest documentation.
author: disler

name: Context Warning
description: Fires graduated warnings at 40%, 25%, and 15% context capacity, giving you a heads-up before compaction is forced.
author: disler

name: Event Logger
description: Logs every Claude tool call as a structured JSON event, enabling real-time observability across multi-agent sessions.
author: disler
